walls.note: Front (bust side) from the Commons photographs: a baldachin of red granite column pairs over the bronze bust, dome with a copper cartouche, gilt crown, shell basins, frogs, lobed pool and black hooped fence. The park is only partly covered by panoramas; the Commons photographs are the evidence.

items.where: eight red polished granite columns with bronze bases and capitals in pairs at the four corners, an arch over each opening, cornice with a segmental pediment on every face
items.how: builder: eight cylinders with bronze base/capital blocks, a stone arch ring and jambs per face, cornice slab, dentil-line box and segmental pediment with an inset panel on each of the four faces

items.where: bronze bust of Dr Samuel Sarphati on a bronze pedestal in the arched opening
items.how: builder: pedestal box, ellipsoid shoulders and head; no facial features, drapery or inscription

items.where: scaled copper-green dome on a drum with oval cartouches and four urns, a vase finial and a gilt crown with a gull on top
items.how: builder: square drum, hemisphere (the fish-scale pattern is not modelled), copper ellipsoid cartouche per face, four urns, two stone vase stages, an open gold crown ring with eight prongs

items.where: four scalloped shell basins with fountain jets on the scaled battered base, bronze frogs at the corners, a lion-head roundel on each dado face
items.how: builder: tapered bowl per face on a stone bracket with a glass water disc, spout sphere, two frogs per face, dado block with red panels and a bronze roundel; water jets, the scale pattern and carved brackets are left out

items.where: lobed stone-rimmed pool about 20 m across inside a black hooped railing, four satellite fountain cups
items.how: builder: rim and coping rings on a four-lobe outline r(th) = 9.0 + 1.1 cos 4th, a dark floor, a fence of 96 posts and bars; the satellite jets are omitted

items.where: SARPHATI in gilt capitals on the front frieze under the pediment
items.how: builder: 5x7 block letters as gold run boxes (pixel-font.ts) on the south entablature

walls.note: Back, east and west faces repeat the basin and dado composition by the four-fold plan (the 2021 photograph shows the west and east basins in profile); the bust faces one side only.
